name: Retired
source: Pathfinder NPC Core, Retired (pg. 81), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterTemplates.aspx?ID=36
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder NPC Core is ORC licensed material.
rules: Decrease its level by 1. Deception if it lacks it (+4 to hide its identity), a Lore from its career in retirement at the high skill value, Rusty and Still Got It!
optional: Typically, remove its combat items, and the attacks and abilities that rely on them: they're usually readily retrievable from a hidden cache. Its +4 circumstance bonus to hide its identity (in Deception's note) is lost against creatures that witness it successfully Striking in combat or using Still Got It! Rusty's -1 status penalty isn't worked into its numbers.

choices.label: Lore from its career in retirement
choices.placeholder: Cooking Lore, Farming Lore, Guild Lore, Sailing Lore, ...

abilities.name: Rusty
abilities.description: {Name} is out of practice. They take a –1 status penalty to all their rolls and DCs. {Name} also rolls twice on initiative rolls and takes the lower result; this is a misfortune effect.

abilities.name: Still Got It!
abilities.description: Frequency once per encounter; Requirements {Name} is in a combat encounter and has either made a critical hit or is in the second round of the encounter; Effect {Name} gains {=max(1, level)} temporary Hit Points that last until the end of the encounter, and suppresses the effects of being rusty until the end of the encounter.
